"value": "Thought:
I think I have found the right product that matches all the requirements. It's time to buy it.

Action:
click[Buy Now]"
tool_call_format.note: Closest value only; json_in_text is not an accurate fit. The README states a 'unified format, i.e., ReAct format', and the trajectory example shows free-text 'Thought:' / 'Action:' with bracket-style actions (click[Buy Now]). That is neither JSON nor XML. No action parser code is in the excerpts. Flag for the Ambiguities list and human review; a 'react_text' value may be needed in the schema.
